genericProblem: An implementation-facing design can describe an owner-to-edge-to-wire property as current fact when the public contract exposes parameters but the owner has not closed filtering, paging, typed failure projection, or a nonvisual consumer contract.

counterexamples.reason: A bounded task read over caller-supplied identifiers is intentionally not a general owner pagination implementation.
Its denominator is physical screens; a nonvisual adapter must not be fabricated as a screen row.
A declared error code is necessary but does not prove that the currently thrown owner subclass reaches it through edge advice.

findings.finding: The candidate-search contract declares filters and paging, but the owner returns an unfiltered List and the edge performs filter/sort/page/total locally; current bytes are GAP-BRAND-CANDIDATE-OWNER-PAGINATION, not server pagination.

The owner throws HeadCompanyBrandAuthorizationInUseException and OpenAPI declares its safe code, but ContractProblemAdvice handles the superclass through generic fallback; explicit typed mapping remains a future P6-3 obligation.
The retired collection-replace path has the finite denominator HeadCompanyManagementPage and static-boundary.test.mjs; the former wording was too vague.
HeadCompanyBrandAuthorizationActionAdapter is nonvisual and needs an explicit consumer/import contract in roster and granularity manifest, not a false physical-screen import row.

preventionDispositions.reason: Every claimed current owner-edge-wire property names evidence at every required layer; otherwise record GAP and future obligation.
A declared code is not projection proof until the actual thrown exception has explicit edge mapping and a focused red mapping test.
The future receipt removes the exact retired page and turns the exact stale assertion into an absence assertion.
Screen-only physical contracts remain screen-only; each nonvisual module records unique consumer, permitted protocol boundary and focused test separately.
